description: Hurricanes and Tropical Cyclones is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri. This map describes the current and recent locations of tropical storms, as well as forecast positions and probable tracks of tropical storms. The areas currently covered by the live feeds are the Atlantic and Eastern Pacific, the Central Pacific (Hawaii, etc.), and the Western Pacific and Indian Ocean. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri. Its keywords are Hurricanes, Cyclone, Live Feed, METAR, NOAA, NHC, CPHC, JTWC. The bounding box given is -103.1444,-6.8937,-4.7069,55.2478. The hub shows 2022-12-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Esri Master License Agreement (terms of use of the source layer, not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
